View code 
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>What fruits do you like?</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="#" method="post">
    <fieldset>
      <legend>What fruits do you like?</legend>

      <div class="checkbox-group" role="group" aria-labelledby="fruits-legend" aria-describedby="fruits-note">
        <div>
          <input type="checkbox" id="fruit-bananas" name="fruits" value="bananas" />
          <label for="fruit-bananas">Bananas</label>
        </div>

        <div>
          <input type="checkbox" id="fruit-oranges" name="fruits" value="oranges" />
          <label for="fruit-oranges">Oranges</label>
        </div>

        <div>
          <input type="checkbox" id="fruit-apples" name="fruits" value="apples" />
          <label for="fruit-apples">Apples</label>
        </div>
      </div>

      <p id="fruits-note">You can change this later.</p>
    </fieldset>

    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Fruit Checkbox Group Validation</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
</head>
<body>
  <form id="fruit-form" method="post" action="#">
    <fieldset>
      <legend>What fruits do you like?</legend>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" name="fruits[]" value="bananas" required> bananas
      </label>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" name="fruits[]" value="oranges" required> oranges
      </label>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" name="fruits[]" value="apples" required> apples
      </label>
    </fieldset>
    <p id="fruit-error" role="alert" aria-live="assertive" style="color:#b00020; display:none; margin-top:8px;">
      You must choose one or more fruits
    </p>
    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
  </form>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('fruit-form');
      const errorEl = document.getElementById('fruit-error');
      const checkboxes = form.querySelectorAll('input[name="fruits[]"]');

      function validateGroup() {
        const anyChecked = Array.prototype.some.call(checkboxes, function (cb) {
          return cb.checked;
        });
        if (!anyChecked) {
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          return false;
        }
        errorEl.style.display = 'none';
        return true;
      }

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        if (!validateGroup()) {
          e.preventDefault();
          form.reportValidity(); // show native tooltips for other fields if any
        }
      });

      checkboxes.forEach(function (cb) {
        cb.addEventListener('change', function () {
          if (cb.checked) {
            errorEl.style.display = 'none';
          }
        });
      });
    })();

<form id="fruit-form" novalidate>
  <fieldset>
    <legend>What fruits do you like?</legend>

    <label>
      <input type="checkbox" name="fruits" value="bananas"> Bananas
    </label>
    <label>
      <input type="checkbox" name="fruits" value="oranges"> Oranges
    </label>
    <label>
      <input type="checkbox" name="fruits" value="apples"> Apples
    </label>

    <div id="fruit-error" role="alert" aria-live="polite" style="color: #b00020; margin-top: 8px;"></div>

    <div style="margin-top: 12px;">
      <button type="submit">Submit</button>
    </div>
  </fieldset>
</form>

<script>
  (function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('fruit-form');
    const errorEl = document.getElementById('fruit-error');
    const checkboxes = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('input[name="fruits"]'));
    const errorMessage = 'You must choose one or more fruits';

    function updateError() {
      const anyChecked = checkboxes.some(cb => cb.checked);
      errorEl.textContent = anyChecked ? '' : errorMessage;
    }

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
      updateError();
      if (!checkboxes.some(cb => cb.checked)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        checkboxes[0].focus();
      }
    });

    checkboxes.forEach(cb => cb.addEventListener('change', updateError));
  })();
</script>

G2 Checkbox group: What fruits do you like? with options bananas, oranges, apples
View code 
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Checkbox Group: What fruits do you like?</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form id="fruit-form" action="#" method="get">
    <fieldset>
      <legend>What fruits do you like?</legend>

      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" name="fruits" value="bananas" />
        Bananas
      </label>

      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" name="fruits" value="oranges" />
        Oranges
      </label>

      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" name="fruits" value="apples" />
        Apples
      </label>

      <button type="submit">Submit</button>
      <button type="reset">Reset</button>
    </fieldset>

    <p id="selected-output" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </form>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('fruit-form');
      const output = document.getElementById('selected-output');

      function updateSelected() {
        const checked = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('input[name="fruits"]:checked'));
        const values = checked.map(cb => cb.value);
        output.textContent = values.length
          ? 'Selected: ' + values.join(', ')
          : 'No fruits selected yet.';
      }

      form.addEventListener('change', updateSelected);
      updateSelected();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Pick a color</title>
  <style>
    :root { color-scheme: light dark; }
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; padding: 2rem; }
    .field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; max-width: 28rem; }
    label { font-weight: 600; }
    input[type="color"] { width: 3rem; height: 3rem; padding: 0; border: none; background: none; }
    .preview { width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: .25rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, CanvasText 25%, transparent); }
    .code { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: .8; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="field">
    <label for="colorPicker">Pick a color</label>
    <input id="colorPicker" type="color" value="#0ea5e9" aria-describedby="colorValue" />
    <span id="colorValue" class="code">#0ea5e9</span>
    <span id="colorPreview" class="preview" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  </div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const picker = document.getElementById('colorPicker');
      const valueEl = document.getElementById('colorValue');
      const preview = document.getElementById('colorPreview');

      function update() {
        const hex = picker.value.toUpperCase();
        valueEl.textContent = hex;
        preview.style.backgroundColor = hex;
      }

      picker.addEventListener('input', update);
      update(); // initialize
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <span id="colorValue" aria-live="polite">#1e90ff</span>

    (function () {
      const picker = document.getElementById('colorPicker');
      const valueEl = document.getElementById('colorValue');

      function update() {
        valueEl.textContent = picker.value;
      }

      picker.addEventListener('input', update);
      update();
    })();
  </script>
</body>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <title>Pick a color</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
</head>
<body>
  <label for="colorPicker">Pick a color</label>
  <input type="color" id="colorPicker" name="colorPicker" value="#0ea5e9" aria-label="Pick a color" />
  <div id="colorPreview" role="status" aria-live="polite" style="margin-top:8px;width:120px;height:40px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;"></div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const picker = document.getElementById('colorPicker');
      const preview = document.getElementById('colorPreview');

      function updatePreview() {
        preview.style.backgroundColor = picker.value;
        preview.textContent = picker.value.toUpperCase();
        preview.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Selected color ' + picker.value.toUpperCase());
      }

      picker.addEventListener('input', updatePreview);
      updatePreview();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Pick a color</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; padding: 2rem; }
    .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; }
    label { font-weight: 600; }
    output { min-width: 7ch; display: inline-block; text-align: center; padding: .25rem .5rem; border-radius: .375rem; background: #f3f4f6; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="row">
    <label for="colorPicker">Pick a color</label>
    <input id="colorPicker" name="color" type="color" value="#1e90ff" aria-label="Pick a color" />
    <output id="colorValue" for="colorPicker">#1e90ff</output>
  </div>

  <script>
    const picker = document.getElementById('colorPicker');
    const out = document.getElementById('colorValue');
    const update = () => { out.value = picker.value; out.textContent = picker.value; };
    picker.addEventListener('input', update);
    update();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Terms Agreement</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form id="signup-form" action="#" method="post">
    <div>
      <input type="checkbox" id="agree" name="agree" required />
      <label for="agree">
        I agree to the <a href="/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms and Conditions</a>
      </label>
    </div>
    <button type="submit" id="submit-btn" disabled>Create Account</button>
  </form>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const checkbox = document.getElementById('agree');
      const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submit-btn');

      function updateState() {
        submitBtn.disabled = !checkbox.checked;
      }

      checkbox.addEventListener('change', updateState);
      updateState(); // initialize on load
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Birthdate Field</title>

<body>
  <label for="birthdate">Birthdate</label>
  <input
    id="birthdate"
    name="birthdate"
    type="date"
    required
    autocomplete="bday"
    min="1900-01-01"
  />

  <script>
    (function () {
      var input = document.getElementById('birthdate');
      if (!input) return;

      // Set max to today (local date) to prevent future dates
      var now = new Date();
      var yyyy = now.getFullYear();
      var mm = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
      var dd = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      input.max = yyyy + '-' + mm + '-' + dd;

      // Optional: clamp value if user has an invalid pre-filled value
      if (input.value && input.value > input.max) {
        input.value = '';
      }
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Event Time</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form id="event-form">
    <label for="event-time">Event Time</label>
    <input
      type="datetime-local"
      id="event-time"
      name="eventTime"
      required
      inputmode="numeric"
    />
    <button type="submit">Save</button>
  </form>

  <pre id="output" aria-live="polite"></pre>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const input = document.getElementById('event-time');
      const output = document.getElementById('output');
      const form = document.getElementById('event-form');

      // Default to current local time (rounded to minutes)
      if (!input.value) {
        const now = new Date();
        now.setMinutes(now.getMinutes() - now.getTimezoneOffset());
        input.value = now.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
      }

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!input.value) {
          input.reportValidity();
          return;
        }
        const selected = new Date(input.value);
        output.textContent = 'Selected: ' + selected.toLocaleString();
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<html lang="en">

  <title>Event Time Input</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; margin: 2rem; }

      id="event-time"
      name="eventTime"
      type="datetime-local"
      required
    />
    <div style="height: 0.75rem"></div>
    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
  </form>

  <script>
    // Set minimum selectable time to now (local time)
    (function () {
      const input = document.getElementById('event-time');
      if (!input) return;
      const toLocalDatetime = (d) => {
        const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
        return d.getFullYear() + '-' +
               pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' +
               pad(d.getDate()) + 'T' +
               pad(d.getHours()) + ':' +
               pad(d.getMinutes());
      };
      input.min = toLocalDatetime(new Date());
    })();
  </script>
</body>

minimax/minimax-m2 G1 Insert an email field for “Email Address” with a validation error “Your email address is invalid.”
View code 
<form id="emailForm" novalidate>
  <label for="email">Email Address</label>
  <input
    type="email"
    id="email"
    name="email"
    required
    aria-describedby="email-error"
    aria-invalid="false"
  />
  <div id="email-error" role="alert" aria-live="polite" style="color: #b00020; display: none;">
    Your email address is invalid.
  </div>
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const emailInput = document.getElementById('email');
      const errorEl = document.getElementById('email-error');

      function showEmailError() {
        errorEl.style.display = 'block';
        emailInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
      }

      function hideEmailError() {
        errorEl.style.display = 'none';
        emailInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
      }

      emailInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
        // Clear any custom validity while typing to let the browser re-validate
        emailInput.setCustomValidity('');
        if (emailInput.checkValidity()) {
          hideEmailError();
        }
      });

      emailInput.addEventListener('blur', function () {
        // On blur, show the required message if empty, else our custom invalid message
        if (emailInput.validity.valueMissing) {
          emailInput.setCustomValidity('Please enter your email address.');
        } else {
          emailInput.setCustomValidity('Your email address is invalid.');
        }
        emailInput.reportValidity();
        if (!emailInput.checkValidity()) {
          showEmailError();
        } else {
          hideEmailError();
        }
      });

      emailInput.addEventListener('invalid', function () {
        // Ensure our exact message is shown for invalid emails
        if (!emailInput.validity.valueMissing) {
          emailInput.setCustomValidity('Your email address is invalid.');
        }
        showEmailError();
      });

      document.getElementById('emailForm').addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        // Final check on submit
        if (!emailInput.checkValidity()) {
          e.preventDefault();
          showEmailError();
          emailInput.reportValidity();
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
</form>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Email Field with Validation Error</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; margin: 2rem; }
    .field { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; }
    input[type="email"] { width: 100%; max-width: 24rem; padding: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #bbb; border-radius: 4px; }
    .error { color: #b00020; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
    .error[hidden] { display: none; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form id="emailForm" novalidate>
    <div class="field">
      <label for="email">Email Address</label>
      <input
        id="email"
        name="email"
        type="email"
        required
        aria-describedby="email-error"
        aria-invalid="false"
      />
      <p id="email-error" class="error" role="alert" aria-live="polite" hidden>
        Your email address is invalid.
      </p>
    </div>

    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
  </form>

  <script>
    (function () {

<form id="email-form" novalidate>
  <div>
    <label for="email">Email Address</label>
    <input
      id="email"
      name="email"
      type="email"
      required
      autocomplete="email"
      inputmode="email"
      aria-describedby="email-error"
      aria-invalid="false"
    />

  </div>
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('email-form');
      const emailInput = document.getElementById('email');
      const errorEl = document.getElementById('email-error');
      const errorMessage = 'Your email address is invalid.';

      function showError() {
        errorEl.textContent = errorMessage;
        emailInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
      }

      function clearError() {
        errorEl.textContent = '';
        emailInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
      }

      emailInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
        if (emailInput.value === '') {
          clearError();
          return;
        }
        if (emailInput.validity.valid) {
          clearError();
        } else {
          showError();
        }
      });

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (emailInput.validity.valid) {
          clearError();
          alert('Submitted: ' + emailInput.value);
        } else {
          showError();
          emailInput.focus();
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>

<!doctype html>

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Accessible Unrestricted File Upload</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --focus: #0a7cff;
      --border: #c7c7c7;
      --text: #111;
      --muted: #555;
      --bg: #fff;
      --hover: #f6f6f6;
    }

    body {
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji";
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--bg);
      margin: 0;
      padding: 2rem;
    }

    .field {
      max-width: 32rem;
    }

    .label {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .5rem;
      padding: .625rem 1rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: .5rem;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .label:hover {
      background: var(--hover);
    }

    .label:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--focus);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .hint {
      display: block;

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Upload Photo</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; padding: 24px; }
    .upload { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .upload input[type="file"] { display: none; }
    .upload .button {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #c7c7c7;
      background: #f7f7f7; cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
      font-weight: 600; color: #222;
    }
    .upload .button:hover { background: #efefef; }
    .upload .hint { font-size: 0.9rem; color: #555; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="#" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data">
    <label class="upload" for="photo">
      <span class="button" role="button" aria-controls="photo">Upload Photo</span>
      <input id="photo" name="photo" type="file" accept="image/*" aria-label="Upload Photo" />
      <span class="hint" id="photo-hint">No file chosen</span>
    </label>
  </form>

  <script>
    const input = document.getElementById('photo');
    const hint = document.getElementById('photo-hint');
    input.addEventListener('change', () => {
      hint.textContent = input.files && input.files.length ? input.files[0].name : 'No file chosen';
    });
  </script>
</body

<form id="passwordForm" novalidate>
  <label for="newPassword">New password</label>
  <input
    type="password"
    id="newPassword"
    name="newPassword"
    minlength="8"
    required
    aria-describedby="passwordError"
    aria-invalid="false"
  />
  <p id="passwordError" role="alert" style="color:#b00020; display:none;">Too short. Must be at least 8 characters.</p>
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const input = document.getElementById('newPassword');
      const error = document.getElementById('passwordError');

      function updateError() {
        const v = input.validity;
        if (v.tooShort) {
          input.setCustomValidity('Too short. Must be at least 8 characters.');
          error.style.display = 'block';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
        } else {
          input.setCustomValidity('');
          error.style.display = 'none';
          input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
        }
      }

      input.addEventListener('input', updateError);
      input.addEventListener('blur', updateError);

      document.getElementById('passwordForm').addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        updateError();
        if (!input.checkValidity()) {
          e.preventDefault();
          input.reportValidity();
        } else {
          e.preventDefault();
          alert('Password is valid.');
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
</form>

<form id="contact-form" novalidate>
  <label for="phone">Phone number</label>
  <input
    id="phone"
    name="phone"
    type="tel"
    inputmode="tel"
    autocomplete="tel"
    placeholder="+1 555-123-4567"
    pattern="^\+?[0-9\s().-]{7,20}$"
    maxlength="25"
    required
    aria-describedby="phone-help phone-error"
    aria-invalid="false"
  />
  <small id="phone-help">Enter a valid phone number (digits, spaces, parentheses, dashes, periods, and optional leading +).</small>
  <div id="phone-error" role="alert" aria-live="polite" style="color:#b00020; margin-top:4px;"></div>
</form>

<script>
  (function () {
    const phoneInput = document.getElementById('phone');
    const errorEl = document.getElementById('phone-error');

    function validatePhone() {
      const value = phoneInput.value.trim();
      const re = /^\+?[0-9\s().-]{7,20}$/;

      if (!value) {
        errorEl.textContent = '';
        phoneInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
        return true;
      }

      if (!re.test(value)) {
        errorEl.textContent = 'Please enter a valid phone number.';
        phoneInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
        return false;
      }

      errorEl.textContent = '';
      phoneInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
      return true;
    }

    phoneInput.addEventListener('input', validatePhone);
    phoneInput.addEventListener('blur', validatePhone);
  })();
</script>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Item Quantity Field</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form id="quantity-form">
    <label for="item-quantity">Item Quantity</label>
    <input
      id="item-quantity"
      name="quantity"
      type="number"
      inputmode="numeric"
      min="1"
      step="1"
      required
      aria-describedby="quantity-hint"
    />
    <div id="quantity-hint" aria-live="polite">Enter a whole number (minimum 1).</div>
    <output id="quantity-output" aria-live="polite"></output>
    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
  </form>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const input = document.getElementById('item-quantity');
      const output = document.getElementById('quantity-output');
      const form = document.getElementById('quantity-form');

      function update() {
        const val = input.valueAsNumber;
        if (Number.isNaN(val)) {
          output.textContent = 'No value';
        } else {
          output.textContent = 'Value: ' + val;
        }
      }

      input.addEventListener('input', update);
      update();

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!input.checkValidity()) {
          input.reportValidity();
          return;
        }
        const qty = input.valueAsNumber;
        alert('Submitted quantity: ' + qty);
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<form id="themeForm" novalidate>
  <fieldset>
    <legend>Theme</legend>
    <label>
      <input type="radio" name="theme" value="light"> Light
    </label>
    <label>
      <input type="radio" name="theme" value="dark"> Dark
    </label>
    <label>
      <input type="radio" name="theme" value="high-contrast"> High contrast
    </label>
  </fieldset>

  <div id="themeError" role="alert" aria-live="assertive" style="color: #b00020; margin-top: 8px; display: none;">
    You must choose a theme to proceed
  </div>

  <button type="submit" style="margin-top: 12px;">Continue</button>
</form>

<script>
  (function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('themeForm');
    const errorEl = document.getElementById('themeError');
    const radios = form.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme"]');

    function showError() {
      errorEl.style.display = 'block';
      errorEl.textContent = 'You must choose a theme to proceed';
    }

    function hideError() {
      errorEl.style.display = 'none';
      errorEl.textContent = '';
    }

    radios.forEach(function (r) {
      r.addEventListener('change', hideError);
      r.addEventListener('invalid', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        showError();
      });
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const selected = form.querySelector('input[name="theme"]:checked');
      if (!selected) {
        showError();
        return;
      }
      hideError();
      alert('Selected theme: ' + selected.value);
    });
  })();
</script>

<form id="theme-form" novalidate>
  <fieldset>
    <legend>Theme</legend>
    <p id="theme-error" role="alert" aria-live="assertive" style="color: #b00020; margin: 0.5rem 0 0;">You must choose a theme to proceed</p>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; margin-top: 0.5rem;">
      <label>
        <input type="radio" name="theme" value="light"> Light
      </label>
      <label>
        <input type="radio" name="theme" value="dark"> Dark
      </label>
      <label>
        <input type="radio" name="theme" value="high-contrast"> High contrast
      </label>
    </div>
  </fieldset>
  <div style="margin-top: 1rem;">
    <button type="submit">Continue</button>
  </div>
  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('theme-form');
      const errorEl = document.getElementById('theme-error');
      const radios = form.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme"]');

      function showError() {
        errorEl.style.display = 'block';
        radios.forEach(r => r.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true'));
      }

      function clearError() {
        errorEl.style.display = 'none';
        radios.forEach(r => r.removeAttribute('aria-invalid'));
      }

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        const selected = form.querySelector('input[name="theme"]:checked');
        if (!selected) {
          e.preventDefault();
          showError();
          const first = radios[0];
          if (first) first.focus();
        } else {
          clearError();
        }
      });

      radios.forEach(r => {
        r.addEventListener('change', clearError);
      });

      // Hide error by default; remove the next line if you want it visible initially
      clearError();
    })();
  </script>
</form>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Volume Range Slider</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

  <label for="volume">Volume</label>
  <input type="range" id="volume" name="volume" min="1" max="10" value="5" step="1" aria-label="Volume">
  <output id="volumeValue" for="volume">5</output>
  <script>
    (function () {
      const slider = document.getElementById('volume');
      const out = document.getElementById('volumeValue');
      const update = () => { out.value = slider.value; out.textContent = slider.value; };
      slider.addEventListener('input', update);
      update();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>

      volumeValue.textContent = volume.value;
      volume.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', volume.value);
    });

    volume.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', volume.value);
  </script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Search Field with Hidden Label</title>
  <style>
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }
    body {
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      margin: 2rem;
    }
    .search-field {
      max-width: 480px;
    }
    .search-field input[type="search"] {
      width: 100%;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem;
      border: 1px solid #c7c7c7;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }
    .search-field input[type="search"]:focus {
      outline: 2px solid #4c9ffe;
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-color: #4c9ffe;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form class="search-field" action="/search" method="get" role="search">
    <label class="sr-only" for="search-input">Search for</label>
    <input
      id="search-input"
      name="q"
      type="search"
      placeholder="Search for..."
      autocomplete="off"
      spellcheck="false"
      aria-label="Search for"
    />
  </form>
</body>

<script>
  (function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('contactForm');
    const textarea = document.getElementById('message');
    const errorEl = document.getElementById('message-error');
    const MIN_WORDS = 20;

    function countWords(text) {
      if (!text) return 0;
      return text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
    }

    function showError() {
      errorEl.hidden = false;
      textarea.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    }

    function hideError() {
      errorEl.hidden = true;
      textarea.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
    }

    function validate() {
      const words = countWords(textarea.value);
      if (words < MIN_WORDS) {
        showError();
        return false;
      }
      hideError();
      return true;
    }

    textarea.addEventListener('input', validate);
    textarea.addEventListener('blur', validate);

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
      if (!validate()) {
        e.preventDefault();
        textarea.focus();
      }
    });
  })();

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Message with Character Counter</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
</head>
<body>
  <label for="message">Message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="5" maxlength="200" placeholder="Enter your message..." aria-describedby="messageCounter"></textarea>
  <div id="messageCounter" aria-live="polite">200 characters remaining</div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const textarea = document.getElementById('message');
      const counter = document.getElementById('messageCounter');
      const max = textarea.maxLength || 200;

      function updateCounter() {
        const remaining = max - textarea.value.length;
        counter.textContent = remaining + ' characters remaining';
      }

      textarea.addEventListener('input', updateCounter);
      updateCounter();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Accessible Message Field with Character Counter</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
</head>
<body>
  <form action="#" method="post">
    <div>
      <label for="message">Message</label>
      <p id="message-hint" class="hint">Enter your message (up to 200 characters).</p>
      <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="5" cols="40" maxlength="200" aria-describedby="message-hint message-counter" aria-invalid="false" required></textarea>
      <div id="message-counter" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">0/200 characters</div>
    </div>
    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
  </form>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const textarea = document.getElementById('message');
      const counter = document.getElementById('message-counter');
      const max = textarea.getAttribute('maxlength') ? parseInt(textarea.getAttribute('maxlength'), 10) : 200;

      function update() {
        const used = textarea.value.length;
        counter.textContent = used + '/' + max + ' characters';
        textarea.setAttribute('aria-invalid', used > max ? 'true' : 'false');
      }

      textarea.addEventListener('input', update);
      update();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Meeting Time</title>
</head>

  <form id="meeting-form">
    <label for="meeting-time">Meeting Time</label>
    <input
      type="time"
      id="meeting-time"
      name="meeting_time"
      step="60"
      required
    />
    <output id="meeting-output" for="meeting-time"></output>
  </form>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const input = document.getElementById('meeting-time');
      const output = document.getElementById('meeting-output');

      function update() {
        output.textContent = input.value ? `Selected time: ${input.value}` : '';
      }

      input.addEventListener('input', update);
      update(); // initialize
    })();
  </script>
</body>

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(checkbox => {
  checkbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
    const label = this.nextElementSibling;
    if (this.checked) {
      label.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    } else {
      label.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    }
  });
});
</script>

            left: 0;

            transform: translateX(24px);
        }

        input:disabled + .slider {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        .status-text {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #666;
            margin-top: 12px;
        }
    </style>
</head>

<div class="toggle-container">
  <label for="notifications-toggle" class="toggle-label">
    Notifications
  </label>
  <button
    id="notifications-toggle"
    role="switch"
    aria-checked="false"
    aria-labelledby="notifications-label"
    class="toggle-switch"
    onclick="toggleNotifications()"
  >
    <span class="toggle-track">
      <span class="toggle-thumb"></span>
    </span>
    <span class="sr-only">Toggle notifications</span>
  </button>
</div>

<script>
  function toggleNotifications() {
    const toggle = document.getElementById('notifications-toggle');
    const isChecked = toggle.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true';
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-checked', !isChecked);
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', isChecked ? 'Notifications off' : 'Notifications on');
  }
</script>

      placeholder="https://example.com"
      inputmode="url"

    />

    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('urlForm');
      const urlInput = document.getElementById('websiteUrl');

      // Optional: normalize by ensuring a protocol is present
      function normalizeUrl(value) {
        const v = value.trim();
        if (!v) return '';
        if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(v)) return v;
        return 'https://' + v;
      }

        e.preventDefault();

        // Let the browser validate first
        if (!form.checkValidity()) {
          form.reportValidity();
